m.t: Jsou na čestné radě a budou dávat vám prohlídku.
m.e: They are on the Honor Board and they'll be giving you the tour.

m.e: You're exactly what this committee's been missing.

m.e: Yeah, look what happened to the Wesen Council.

m.e: I am willing to restore the Hamilton family's seat on the privy council.

m.e: Yes, I'd reported the fraud to the Board of Controls.

m.t: Poslat zase nějakej dopis školní radě.
m.e: Write another letter to the goddamn school board.

m.t: Vy přece v radě jste, ne?
m.e: You're on the Board, aren't you?

m.t: Budeme se vídat v tajné radě.
m.e: We will see each other at the Privy Council.

m.t: Ptali se na to v Radě?
m.e: Did this come up in the Council?

m.e: We don't have time to waste on the damn board!

m.t: Pořád ho chceš v radě?
m.e: You still want him on the board?

m.t: - Byl jste v radě firmy Schwinn, když se to všechno stalo, ne?
m.e: - You were on the board of Schwinn when all that happened, no?

m.e: -Well, can we call, I don't know, the school board?

m.e: We merely sit on the council.

m.e: Who runs the council?

m.e: No, I'm on the board.

m.t: Chci křeslo v radě.
m.e: I want a seat on the council.

m.e: Not to mention the school board?

m.t: V radě, kterou ovládám.
m.e: A board which I control.

m.t: Zodpovídáme se Kontrolní radě.
m.e: We answer to the Board of Control.

m.t: - Místo ve státní radě?
m.e: A seat on the privy council?

m.t: - Řekl jsi to radě?
m.e: Have you told the Council?

m.e: I would rather it was women who were advising me than anyone else, since it often takes a woman to know another woman.

m.t: Uděláš to hned, nebo mám zavolat radě?
m.e: Are you gonna do it now, or do I have to call the rest of the board?

m.e: And I'm gonna pass this sucker, thanks to your sage advice.

m.t: Díky jeho radě jsem ušetřil dost peněz.
m.e: Thanks to his advice, I have saved a lot of money.

m.e: I pray the blessings of Almighty God may rest upon your counsel.

m.e: - I will die before I let you through this door.

m.t: A já nemůžu jít, dokud nepůjdeš ty, a když nepůjdeš, zemřu.

m.e: I'll die before I let him join your army.

m.t: Tak alespoň zemřu šťastný... když budu vědět, že ses konečně v něčem spletl.

m.t: A jestli musím zemřít, tak zemřu, brácho.
